notes.title: Added difficulties
notes.content: Added 3 difficulties, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Easy increases HP when leveling up, increase amount of XP, and increase amount of given damage. Normal is the same. Hard decreases hp, xp, and damage given.

notes.title: Update for 5/26/24
